visual_limitations: Inherited rock has a photographic appearance and is preserved.
visual_review: Inspected final PNG and 512px JPEG. Three small ascending stones are visible on previously open rock beside Pepe. Original wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes, rock, cracks, light and framing remain. Both inherited hands retain four fingers and one thumb each, five digits each. No new hands or stencils; no letters, numerals, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people or prohibited symbols seen.
